notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
This update contains:
- minor bug fixes
- native Apple Silicon support for mac users

please note: if any mac users experience an issue when launching the app which can happen in some rare cases, the easiest solution is to uninstall and then reinstall the app.

notes.title: Further improvements to Zoom speeds
notes.content:
We've made some further improvements to the zoom speed when scrolling using a mouse, particularly for Windows users. To account for possible differences in input devices and OS settings we've also added a 'Zoom Sensitivity' slider to adjust the speed, found under Options > Controls > Mouse. 

We've also added a couple of new alternative keyboard shortcuts to go with the WASD used for panning, you can now also use QE for rotating and RF for zoom in / out.  

Thank you for your feedback everyone!

notes.title: Zoom & Rotate input speeds improved
notes.content: Thanks to early review feedback we've more than doubled the speed of zooming in and out using a mouse. Rotating when using a gamepad, keyboard or mouse have also received notable speed increases.
